name: Linkoryx – Custom Post & Page Links
author: Burhan Nasir

sections.description: This plugin allows you to make a WordPress page (or post or custom post type) link to a URL of your choosing, instead of its WordPress URL. It also redirects people who go to the old (or “normal”) URL to the new one you’ve chosen.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/linkoryx/, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit any post or page and use the meta box in the sidebar to set a redirect URL.
sections.faq:
Which post types are supported?

The redirect meta box appears on posts, pages, and all public custom post types.
